senses.def: A parish in Scottish Borders council area, Scotland, that includes the villages of Kirk Yetholm and Town Yetholm, which are separated by the river Bowmont Water. Historically in Roxburghshire.
A locality in the Bathurst council area, central eastern New South Wales, Australia.
A yeti-human hybrid as identified by Stanisław Szukalski.
A surname.
A locality in the Inverell council area, north eastern New South Wales, Australia.
A village and civil parish (served by the group Parish Council of Yetminster and Ryme Intrinseca) in West Dorset, England (OS grid ref ST5910).
A census-designated place in Tulare County, California, United States.
A surname.
up to the present time
ex: I have yet to see the results
details are yet to be worked out

senses.def: used in negative statement to describe a situation that has existed up to this point or up to the present time
ex: So far he hasn't called
the sun isn't up yet

senses.def: to a greater degree or extent; used with comparisons
ex: looked sick and felt even worse
an even (or still) more interesting problem

senses.def: within an indefinite time or at an unspecified future time
ex: he longed for the flowers that were yet to show themselves
sooner or later you will have to face the facts

senses.def: used after a superlative
ex: this is the best so far
the largest drug bust yet

senses.def: despite anything to the contrary (usually preceding a concession)
ex: although I'm a little afraid, however I'd like to try it
while we disliked each other, nevertheless we agreed

senses.def: In negative or interrogative use, often with an expectation or potential of something happening in the future.
ex: I haven't finished yet.
Have you finished yet?

senses.def: In negative imperative use, asking for an action to be delayed.
ex: Don't switch it on yet – wait until I've reconnected the pump.

senses.def: At some future time; eventually.
ex: The riddle will be solved yet.

senses.def: Not as of the time referenced.
ex: I’ve yet to see him. — I have not yet seen him.
I had yet to go to a convention. — I had not yet gone to a convention.

senses.def: In addition.
ex: There are two hours yet to go until our destination.

senses.def: Even.
ex: K-2 is yet higher than this.
Oh no! Yet more problems!

senses.def: Nevertheless; however; but; despite that.
ex: I thought I knew you, yet how wrong was I!
It’s incredible yet true.

senses.def: A metal pan or boiler; yetling.
To get.
Happening again, after having happened numerous other times.
ex: Late to class yet again, Mr. Potter?
Superman saved the day, yet again.

senses.def: a large hairy humanoid creature said to live in the Himalayas
A furry midlength boot.
Any of the genus Kiwa of anomurans that live around deep-sea hydrothermal vents and cold seeps, and have hairy and bristly appearances, reminiscent of yetis.
Synonym of yeti crab.
Resembling or characteristic of a yeti.
A small cauldron, or rounded pot, typically, but not always, made of cast iron.
A small cast iron ball.
Gate.
A gate made of iron bars, used for defensive purposes in castles and other buildings, which is hinged to open like a door, rather than being raised and lowered like a portcullis.
A desire or impulse.
The human inclination toward evil.
